strategy: additive isolated canary; no active node or state replacement
promotion: blocked until target directory, baseline semantics and live verification are confirmed
runtime_directory: explicit operator-selected private ServerSpace runtime directory; no inferred production path

bits.2: canonical state digest and dataset CRCs validated

peer_authentication: SO_PEERCRED owner UID and response PID; HMAC-SHA256 nonce-bound namespace handshake
api_gate: python runtime/serverspace_substrate.py gate --root PRIVATE_RUNTIME_DIRECTORY --namespace INDEPENDENT_CONTEXT --timeout 30 -- REVIEWED_MINING_API_COMMAND
writer: write_state(root, namespace, datasets, expected_revision); exclusive flock, revision conflict rejection, fsync atomic rename, exact readback
state_continuity: persistent mmap and canonical file survive worker restart; no existing state imported without validation
watchdog: single-owner local recovery; failed handshake or worker exit triggers bounded restart; not multi-host high availability
projection_isolation: namespace identity required; no scalar-unity inference or parent-context merging
mathematical_scope: byte integrity and revision invariants only; owner environmental conditioning/algebra requires supplied verified contract
transport_scope: bounded length-and-CRC framed UDS messages; test evidence does not prove loss-free arbitrary networks
rollback: stop only this canary watchdog; keep its data quarantined for inspection; existing nodes unchanged
integration_requirements: map the actual ServerSpace directory and service user
compare mmap ABI and canonical state schema to active baseline
check all assigned workers and resource limits
verify TLS peers and external network frame receipts
smoke-test publication, routes and internal/external endpoints
promote one compatible component at a time
